answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 5819 Country: Pakistan Title: I am a student of class 8th. tie is compulsory in my school.Is it halal or haram.the second thing is compulsion.so what i do? Question: Aasalamualikum I am a student of class 8th. tie is compulsory in my school.Is it halal or haram.the second thing is compulsion.so what i do? Answer ID: 5819 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 411/411=M-1429) Tie is an emblem of Christians, and adopting the emblem of any religion is not only unlawful but also is against Islamic spirit. When tie is compulsory in your school, you should get admission in a school where such thing is not in force. If there is no such alternative school and tie is so compulsory in your school that if opposed you may be expelled out, then in such case you should wear tie only in school timings and you should never wear otherwise. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
